criteria_coverage.criterion: Resource files are downloadable through an HTTP endpoint for a published resource
tests: route.test.ts: returns 200 and creates a Download row for a PUBLISHED resource
criteria_coverage.notes: 200 success path asserted. Test asserts body.success===true but does NOT assert the contract-required `fileUrl` field is present in the JSON body.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Each successful download increments a persistent, per-resource counter exactly once
criteria_coverage.notes: Verifies db.download.create called exactly once with { data: { resourceId: '1', userId: null } }. Strong.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Failed / rejected download requests do NOT increment the counter
tests: route.test.ts: 404 for DRAFT resource — create NOT called
route.test.ts: 404 for missing resource — create NOT called
route.test.ts: 500 when findUnique throws — create NOT called
criteria_coverage.notes: Negative-path coverage is solid. No test for a 500 originating from download.create itself throwing (partial-failure branch of contract 500).

criteria_coverage.criterion: Resource card displays download count for that resource
criteria_coverage.notes: Rendering of downloadCount verified. Title rendering is NOT asserted, though contract requires title as visible text — a bug that omits/mangles title would slip through this suite.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Resource detail view displays download count
criteria_coverage.notes: Happy path covered. No test for notFound() when resource is missing or DRAFT — contract invariant explicitly requires 404 for unpublished/missing resources on the detail page, and this is not asserted.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Resource owner can query the download count for each of their resources
criteria_coverage.notes: Per contract, owner reads counts via the same profile/detail UI — implicitly covered.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Teacher profile displays total likes summed across published resources
criteria_coverage.notes: F1 asserts totalLikes value; F2 asserts where-clause includes authorId and status PUBLISHED.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Teacher profile displays total downloads summed across published resources
DRAFT / unpublished / deleted resources excluded from aggregates
tests: teachers page.test.ts F2 (asserts status: 'PUBLISHED' in count where-clause)
criteria_coverage.notes: Aggregate-side filter verified for like.count and download.count. Gap: F2 does NOT assert that resource.findMany is also filtered by status: 'PUBLISHED' (contract states DRAFT resources are never returned in the resources list). A bug that leaks DRAFT into the returned resources list would pass.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Teacher with zero published resources sees 0 for both totals
criteria_coverage.notes: Explicit zero-state assertion for totalLikes, totalDownloads, and empty resources array.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Aggregate totals reflect new likes/downloads on next profile page load via revalidatePath
criteria_coverage.notes: Verifies revalidatePath is invoked with the author's teacher path on success. Good.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Download endpoint is publicly accessible (no auth) for published resources (MVP)
tests: route.test.ts happy path succeeds with no auth headers
criteria_coverage.notes: No auth-gate assertion is required; absence of any auth mock and success of the request implicitly covers this.
No visibility gating exists in code under test; not a testable behavior beyond fetch succeeding.

criteria_coverage.criterion: TeacherProfilePage Server Component renders StatsHeaderCard + ResourceCard list (contract)
criteria_coverage.notes: Only the fetchTeacherProfileData helper is tested. The default-export TeacherProfilePage (which the contract explicitly specifies must render StatsHeaderCard and a ResourceCard list) has no rendering test. A regression that swaps components or drops the stats block would not be caught.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Download response body shape { success: true, fileUrl: string | null }
criteria_coverage.notes: Contract specifies fileUrl is part of the JSON body; no test asserts its presence or value. A bug that omits fileUrl (breaking any future client relying on it) would pass.

test_findings.issue: Uses `params: Promise.resolve({ id: '1' })` while contract signature declares `params: { id: string }` (non-Promise). Tester chose the Next 15 async-params form. Not a spec violation but worth noting — coder must match the same shape.
Body assertion is `toMatchObject({ success: true })` — does not verify the `fileUrl` field from the contract's response body shape.

Only tests findUnique-throws → 500. Contract also allows 500 when download.create throws; no test for that branch. A subtle bug that swallows create-errors (returns 200 despite no row) would not be caught.
Only asserts downloadCount rendering. Contract requires `title` to be rendered as visible text; a bug that hides/omits the title passes.
No test for the notFound() invariant when resource is missing or status !== 'PUBLISHED'. Contract explicitly requires this behavior on the resource detail page.

Does not assert that `db.resource.findMany` is called with a `status: 'PUBLISHED'` filter. Contract states DRAFT resources are never returned in the `resources` array. A bug leaking DRAFT into the list would pass.

No test for the default-export Server Component (TeacherProfilePage). Contract requires it renders StatsHeaderCard with the totals and a list of ResourceCard for each published resource; this composition is untested.
Uses getAllByText('0') with length>=2 for the zero case — acceptable but does not distinguish which value is which. Since props are trusted and pure presentational, this is fine.

unmapped_criteria: TeacherProfilePage default-export composition (renders StatsHeaderCard + ResourceCard list) — contract-locked interface with no test.
ResourceDetailPage notFound() for missing or non-PUBLISHED resource — contract invariant with no test.
Download response body includes `fileUrl` field — contract-locked shape not asserted.
one_line_summary: Test suite encodes the core acceptance criteria (download creation, exclusion of DRAFT/missing, per-resource counts, aggregate totals, zero state, revalidatePath); approve with medium confidence given missing coverage for the TeacherProfilePage composition, ResourceDetailPage notFound path, resource.findMany PUBLISHED filter, download.create-throws 500 branch, and the fileUrl response field.
